evidence_quotes: Metsä Group has selected Valmet to deliver a 3D Fiber molded fiber production line for their mill in Äänekoski, Finland.
The order is included in Valmet's orders received for the third quarter of 2026.
data.date_evidence: Valmet Oyj’s press release on August 27, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. EEST
data.reason: The article announces that Valmet has received an order from Metsä Group to deliver a 3D Fiber production line, which constitutes a specific company development.
